name: wf-step-llm
description: Shared LLM step: every model call in the project goes through here, so no prompt text lives in a node. Loads the named obs.prompts row and obs.profiles decode profile via obs.f_step_config, substitutes {{vars}} and throws on any placeholder the caller did not supply, calls Ollama, and enforces the requested JSON schema before returning. Records prompt_sha256, model residency, token counts and latency to obs.steps.

parameters.query: SELECT model, options, body, sha256 FROM obs.f_step_config($1::text, $2::text);
